name: Asim
long_description:
Asim is building standardized benchmarks for physical intelligence, helping robotics companies understand their robots’ capabilities and safety limits before deployment.
We test real robots under changing physical conditions, varying shape, weight, friction and material, to identify where performance breaks down and give engineers actionable feedback.

Our four founders include three PhD researchers, two specializing in robotics, with backgrounds at Sony and NASA JPL and two RoboCup@Home championship wins.

Our ambition is to become the standard robotics teams use to measure progress and assess readiness for deployment.

launches.title: Asim: Find your robot’s safety limits before deployment
launches.tagline: We test real robots under changing physical conditions to uncover failures before deployment around people.
launches.body:
Hey everyone! We’re Douglas, Raphaël, Maëlic and Tristan, the founders of[ Asim](https://www.asim-group.com) (YC F26).

**TL;DR**

We’re building standardized benchmarks for physical intelligence: how well robots handle objects, coordinate movements and adapt when conditions change. We test real robots to help engineering teams measure their capabilities, understand their limitations and identify safety risks before deployment.

<https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=mwA0V_8gfnU>

**The problem**

A robot picks up a glass perfectly in the lab. Then the glass is heavier, the surface is slippery, or someone reaches into its workspace. Does it still behave safely?

Completing a task in one setting doesn’t tell us how reliably a robot will perform when conditions change. A success-or-failure score alone doesn’t explain what caused a failure or how to prevent it.

As robots increasingly operate around people, understanding those limits is critical to safety.

**Our solution**

At Asim, we systematically vary objects, tasks and environments in the real world to find the conditions where robot behavior breaks down.

Our testing examines three things:

* Adaptability: how performance changes when we vary physical properties such as shape, weight, friction and material.
* Robustness: how reliably robots grasp objects, coordinate movements and respond to unexpected changes.
* Failure conditions: which changes a robot can handle, which cause failures and when those failures become safety risks.

Robotics teams get actionable feedback on their robots’ limits for safer deployment around people.

**Why us**

We’re four founders, including three PhD researchers, two specializing in robotics. Our backgrounds include Sony and NASA JPL, world-class research in machine learning and human–robot interaction, and two RoboCup@Home championship wins.

**Our shared mission: enable robots to operate safely in the real world.**

**Our asks**

* **Building or deploying robots? We’d love to hear which tasks and failure modes are hardest for your team to test.**
* **Intros to robotics engineering teams: CTOs, Heads of Robotics and VPs of Engineering preparing robots for deployment around people.**
* **Reach us: email [contact@asim-group.com](mailto:contact@asim-group.com) with the task or failure mode you’re struggling to test.**

**Asim. Benchmarking physical intelligence.**
